arguments.value: Fred Wallace Slaughter was born in 1973 in Santa Monica, California. He earned a B.A. from the University of California, Los Angeles, in 1996 and a J.D. from the University of California, Los Angeles, School of Law, in 1999. He served as a deputy city attorney in Los Angeles, California, from 2000 to 2002, as an assistant U.S. attorney in the District of Arizona from 2002 to 2004, as an assistant U.S. attorney in the Central District of California from 2004 to 2008 and from 2010 to 2014, and as an assistant U.S. attorney in the District of Oregon from 2008 to 2010. He served as a judge of the Superior Court of California, County of Orange, from 2014 to 2022, and was nominated by Joseph R. Biden on December 15, 2021, to the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California, confirmed by the Senate on March 17, 2022, and received his commission on April 19, 2022.
